request.initial_prompt: But in the fear of admitting philosophers to power, because they are no longer to be had simple and earnest, but are made up of mixed elements; and in turning from them to passionate and less complex characters, who are by nature fitted for war rather than peace; and in the value set by them upon military stratagems and contrivances, and in the waging of everlasting wars—this State will be for the most part peculiar.

raw_segments.text: But in the fear of admitting philosophers to power, because they are no longer to be had
simple and earnest, but are made up of mixed elements, and in turning from them to passionate
and less complex characters, who are by nature fitted for war rather than peace, and in the
value set by them upon military stratagems and contrivances, and in the waging of everlasting
wars—this State will be for the most part peculiar.
